text:
Nora Blake: Quick question — my due date moved earlier and I need to start parental leave Aug 22 instead of Sept 5. I already filed for Sept 5 in the portal. How do I update? Also my manager asked whether I can do reduced hours the first two weeks instead of full stop.

Sam (People Ops): Congrats, Nora! First, amend your existing leave in the HR portal (choose "change dates" and attach updated physician note). That tells payroll and benefits to change the effective date. Deadline: do this ASAP to avoid the payroll cutover.

Nora Blake: Got it. If I switch to reduced hours (4 days/week) for the first 2 weeks, does top-up pay change?

benefits-bot: Reduced-schedule note: payroll proration applies. Redwood top-up is prorated for reduced schedule or partial weeks. See: https://handbook.internal/leaves#proration. Please confirm format (e.g., "Mon-Thu" or "4 days/week") in the portal.

Michelle (People Ops): Reduced-schedule is allowed. Manager should confirm coverage expectations in a one-line agreement on the leave form. We'll record proration and ensure benefits are continuous. If you want us to model net pay for the first pay period we can run a quick estimate once you confirm reduced-hours dates.

Nora Blake: Please run estimate. First two weeks reduced (Aug 22–Sep 4, Mon–Thu). I'll upload the doc in the portal today.

Liam O'Connor: For coverage, I can take primary oncall those two weeks. Nora — can you draft a 1-page handoff and pin the critical runbook items? Also we might need CI token rotation.

Nora Blake: Will do. Also — the company policy asked to return my laptop next week for inventory. Can I instead keep it while on reduced schedule? We need it for doctor calls.

IT-Support: If you're approved to retain the device for medical reasons, we can keep it assigned with additional MDM constraints. Submit the IT retention form and include "medical leave — device retention". If approved, we will add location restrictions and enable remote wipe.

Sam (People Ops): We generally approve device retention for medical/family leaves. Upload the IT retention form and copy me; I will fast-track approval.

Nora Blake: Thanks. One more — will approving partial-week schedule affect my vacation accrual or service milestones?

Michelle (People Ops): Parental leave does not stop service accrual. Vacation accrual during paid leave remains as normal if you are on paid weeks; for prorated/unpaid weeks accrual may be paused per payroll rules. We'll include this in the payroll estimate.

benefits-bot: Quick eligibility check: tenure 18 months -> full parental top-up eligible for up to 12 weeks. Reduced schedule proration applies.

Liam O'Connor: I posted a skeleton rota in #eng-oncall and assigned me for Aug 22–Sep 4. Nora, once you post the handoff I'll pick up escalation contacts.

Nora Blake: Uploaded updated physician note and amended dates in HR portal. Also added the reduced-schedule note "Mon-Thu first two weeks".

Sam (People Ops): Received. Sam here — running payroll estimate now and will DM net pay numbers in a couple hours. Also pre-approved device retention pending IT form.

IT-Support: Received retention form. Approved. We'll apply MDM and remote-wipe and send instructions.

Michelle (People Ops): Timeline recap: - Today: Nora submits amended leave and IT retention form (done) - Within 24h: payroll estimate and proration DM - Aug 15: final handoff doc posted - Aug 22: reduced-week schedule begins then transitions to full leave after Sep 4

Nora Blake: Thank you all for the quick turnaround — really helps with planning. :heart:
